comment: Hand-drawn single-NPN bootstrapped clean-to-dirty booster by Gustav Smalley (2001), with design notes; no designators, so quantity refs are used.
rows: collector load, and base to bootstrap node
bias from +9V, and output to ground (note says the output one can be a 100K volume pot)
output coupling, film; drawing says 1uF film or 10uF electrolytic
NPN; drawing also suggests MPSA18, 2N2222A, 2N3904, or try TIP29
5K lin, emitter resistor with bypassed wiper
